READ	SELECT udf(b), udf(c) FROM test_having
READ	SELECT udf(c), max(udf(a)) FROM test_having
READ	SELECT udf(udf(min(udf(a)))), udf(udf(max(udf(a)))) FROM test_having HAVING udf(udf(min(udf(a)))) = udf(udf(max(udf(a)))
READ	SELECT udf(min(udf(a))), udf(udf(max(a))) FROM test_having HAVING udf(min(a)) < udf(max(udf(a)))
READ	SELECT udf(a) FROM test_having HAVING udf(min(a)) < udf(max(a))
READ	SELECT 1 AS one FROM test_having HAVING udf(a) > 1
READ	SELECT 1 AS one FROM test_having HAVING udf(udf(1) > udf(2))
READ	SELECT 1 AS one FROM test_having HAVING udf(udf(1) < udf(2))
READ	SELECT 1 AS one FROM test_having WHERE 1/udf(a) = 1 HAVING 1 < 2
